title: Compact Retry Deck: dense payload inspector + taxonomy filters for quick debug
creator: Maya Chen
description: A compact, stackable 'Retry Deck' card intended for Console's Requests and Rollouts views. Each deck entry summarizes a failed request with taxonomy tags (client/network/model/error-class), a one-line failure digest, inline payload diff sparkline, retry history, and a compact action row (retry, open full payload, add note). The goal is to provide engineers and SREs with a dense, scannable surface that answers: why did this fail, has it been retried, and what changed in the payload between attempts?
problem_statement: Current full-request inspector is powerful but heavyweight for triage. Engineers frequently need a quick signal across a long list of failed requests without opening a large modal. We need a compact view that preserves essential debugging affordances (taxonomy, payload delta, retry status) while keeping Console lists performant.
proposed_solution: Introduce a compact card (compressed vertical height) with progressive disclosure: collapsed mode shows status badge, short error taxonomy chips, 1-line humanized message, retry count + last attempt timestamp, and a 64px-wide sparkline that visualizes token/field diffs across attempts. Expanding the card reveals a small inline diff with key-value highlights and an in-place retry button that triggers a controlled re-execution (backend job id surface). The design keeps heavy payload rendering off the critical path; large payloads lazy-load on explicit expand.
acceptance_criteria: Collapsed card shows: error taxonomy chips, concise digest (<=80 chars), retry count, last attempt timestamp, and diff sparkline.
Taxonomy filters (client|network|model|validation) can be applied at the list-level and persist across sessions.
Inline expand reveals a 5-line summarized diff with field-level highlights and a link to the full payload inspector.
Retry action enqueues a replay job and surfaces an ephemeral toast with job id; UI polls job status and updates retry count on completion.
Card render time (collapsed) <= 150ms for lists of 100 cards; lazy-loading must prevent main list jank.
Edge cases: extremely large payloads show truncated diff and a clear 'open full inspector' affordance; PII fields masked by default per RBAC and data-masking rules.
Design reviewed and signed off by PM and Eng; security checklist validated by Security reviewer.
